subject: Re: Updated Ethernet Switches Links
text:
Hi, Vadim,
Thanks for your interest.
1, Please check the info from below link, you will have a better
understanding of our feature list and OS.
*https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nKIZPptuYQhoUs0FbjyXYStrn2sl4iRU?usp=drive_link*

2, Yes, let's do sample testing.
MOQ is 1pc for any model.
I would suggest STH-8C48DX-HSI (STH25G series) and STH-2C24XF-HSI (XLite
series) for testing.
Prices are 5000USD and 1350USD respectively.

3, We are subject to increasing material costs, mainly about the RAM and
Disk prices...
So we will only quote by models for now, please kindly understand.
Please let me know if you have any interested model after checking the link
above.
We will talk.

4, And we have a small question for you.
Is your business project-based, or you have a plan to build your own
brand(like we provide OEM services)?
This helps us better assist you in the coming talks.

Thank you.
note: SB-121（合并档内 quippro.kz，Vadim Rudenko，抄 momarov@）：Elsa 2026-03-13 实报 CENTEC 样机价 STH-8C48DX-HSI $5,000、STH-2C24XF-HSI $1,350（MOQ 1）；「RAM / 磁盘涨价，只按型号报」；问项目型还是自有品牌
